SOURCE · COMPARISON · REVIEW

THE JOB / THE BASIS

What would your owner accept as an apples-to-apples baseline?

For indirect procurement heads and category managers at midmarket companies with repeat tail-spend purchases.

INPUT

A reviewed outcome, approval reference and comparable prior-purchase basis.

OUTPUT / PROPOSED

A draft PO record and an evidence-linked value report, with unresolved assumptions held.

THE WORKFLOW

A specific job.
A visible review point.

Each step retains the source and the unresolved exception.

01

Define the comparator

Document quantity, specification, freight, delivery and permitted adjustments.

02

Count incremental costs

Include review effort, hourly-rate basis, pilot fees and relevant incremental costs.

03

Separate scenario from outcome

A suggested or unaccepted offer cannot become realized savings.

THE EXAMPLE

Arithmetic is not
evidence of savings.

The synthetic $120 gross difference is held because the delivery basis changed. Review effort and relevant fees must also be included before any value claim.

LIMITS / INTEGRATION SCOPE

Controls that stay in view.

A proposed module is a bounded workflow, not a general-purpose autonomous agent. Source-to-pay mapping would be assessed within a permissioned pilot; no production integration is claimed.

  • A 15-versus-30-day baseline difference stays held.
  • Unaccepted offers are excluded from verified savings.
  • Draft export never issues a PO or writes to ERP.
Read all controls

FAQ

Before you choose the module.

Is the $120 difference a savings claim?

No. It is arithmetic on synthetic inputs, held because delivery differs. The $30 review cost and relevant pilot fees must also be accounted for.

Does the draft export place an order?

No. It is a local-only illustrative handoff. Issuing an order, writing to ERP and payment remain disabled.
